'''M4-I6''' was a small [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The M4-I6 Astromech Droid was a gift given to all players through their mailbox in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a gift for Star Wars Day starting on [[May 4]], [[2016]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
